description: gzapp's GZCoord integration: the Claude-Bridge relay the gzcoord-coordinator hosts, the channel every gzapp agent joins, where a gzapp working copy keeps the relay token and the hosted relay's runtime. Read by communication/gzcoord/scripts/inbox.mjs when the working copy resolves to project gzapp; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. Paths are relative to the working copy.
